sqlGenerado:
SELECT TOP (40)
    currentData.Codigo,
    currentData.Proveedor,
    currentData.TotalActual,
    ISNULL(priorData.TotalAnterior, 0) AS TotalAnterior,
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(priorData.TotalAnterior, 0) > 0
            THEN (currentData.TotalActual - priorData.TotalAnterior) / priorData.TotalAnterior
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Variacion
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.CUENTA AS Codigo,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(c.RAZON_SOCIAL), ''), c.CUENTA) AS Proveedor,
        SUM(c.ImporteDashboard) AS TotalActual
    FROM vw_compras_cabecera_dashboard c
    WHERE (@CurFechaDesde IS NULL OR c.FECHA >= @CurFechaDesde)
AND (@CurFechaHasta IS NULL OR c.FECHA < DATEADD(day, 1, @CurFechaHasta))
AND (@CurProveedor IS NULL OR c.CUENTA LIKE '%' + @CurProveedor + '%' OR c.RAZON_SOCIAL LIKE '%' + @CurProveedor + '%')
AND (@CurUsuario IS NULL OR c.USUARIO = @CurUsuario)
AND (@CurSucursal IS NULL OR c.SUCURSAL = @CurSucursal)
AND (@CurDeposito IS NULL OR CONVERT(varchar(20), c.IdDeposito) = @CurDeposito)
AND (@CurEstado IS NULL OR c.EstadoComprobante = @CurEstado)
AND (@CurTipoComprobante IS NULL OR c.TC = @CurTipoComprobante)
AND (
    (@CurArticulo IS NULL AND @CurArticuloCodigo IS NULL AND @CurArticuloDescripcion IS NULL AND @CurRubro IS NULL AND @CurFamilia IS NULL)
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM vw_compras_detalle_dashboard detailFilter
        WHERE detailFilter.TC = c.TC
          AND detailFilter.IDCOMPROBANTE = c.IDCOMPROBANTE
          AND detailFilter.CUENTA = c.CUENTA
          AND (@CurArticulo IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(detailFilter.IDARTICULO)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@CurArticulo)))
          AND (@CurArticuloCodigo IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(detailFilter.IDARTICULO)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@CurArticuloCodigo)))
          AND (@CurArticuloDescripcion IS NULL OR detailFilter.DESCRIPCION_ARTICULO LIKE '%' + @CurArticuloDescripcion + '%')
          AND (@CurRubro IS NULL OR detailFilter.RUBRO = @CurRubro)
          AND (@CurFamilia IS NULL OR detailFilter.FAMILIA = @CurFamilia)
    )
)
    GROUP BY c.CUENTA
) currentData
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.CUENTA AS Codigo,
        SUM(c.ImporteDashboard) AS TotalAnterior
    FROM vw_compras_cabecera_dashboard c
    WHERE (@PrFechaDesde IS NULL OR c.FECHA >= @PrFechaDesde)
AND (@PrFechaHasta IS NULL OR c.FECHA < DATEADD(day, 1, @PrFechaHasta))
AND (@PrProveedor IS NULL OR c.CUENTA LIKE '%' + @PrProveedor + '%' OR c.RAZON_SOCIAL LIKE '%' + @PrProveedor + '%')
AND (@PrUsuario IS NULL OR c.USUARIO = @PrUsuario)
AND (@PrSucursal IS NULL OR c.SUCURSAL = @PrSucursal)
AND (@PrDeposito IS NULL OR CONVERT(varchar(20), c.IdDeposito) = @PrDeposito)
AND (@PrEstado IS NULL OR c.EstadoComprobante = @PrEstado)
AND (@PrTipoComprobante IS NULL OR c.TC = @PrTipoComprobante)
AND (
    (@PrArticulo IS NULL AND @PrArticuloCodigo IS NULL AND @PrArticuloDescripcion IS NULL AND @PrRubro IS NULL AND @PrFamilia IS NULL)
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM vw_compras_detalle_dashboard detailFilter
        WHERE detailFilter.TC = c.TC
          AND detailFilter.IDCOMPROBANTE = c.IDCOMPROBANTE
          AND detailFilter.CUENTA = c.CUENTA
          AND (@PrArticulo IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(detailFilter.IDARTICULO)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@PrArticulo)))
          AND (@PrArticuloCodigo IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(detailFilter.IDARTICULO)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@PrArticuloCodigo)))
          AND (@PrArticuloDescripcion IS NULL OR detailFilter.DESCRIPCION_ARTICULO LIKE '%' + @PrArticuloDescripcion + '%')
          AND (@PrRubro IS NULL OR detailFilter.RUBRO = @PrRubro)
          AND (@PrFamilia IS NULL OR detailFilter.FAMILIA = @PrFamilia)
    )
)
    GROUP BY c.CUENTA
) priorData ON priorData.Codigo = currentData.Codigo
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(priorData.TotalAnterior, 0) > 0
            THEN (currentData.TotalActual - priorData.TotalAnterior) / priorData.TotalAnterior
        ELSE -1
    END DESC,
    currentData.TotalActual DESC
